common_definitions.exact_sufficiency: rho is exactly sufficient for b iff there exists d:ρ[X]→V^T such that b=d∘rho on X
common_definitions.collision_criterion: rho is exactly sufficient iff rho(x)=rho(y) implies b(x)=b(y) for all x,y∈X

far_core_010_dependency.rule: Changing Γ alone while L, J, I and the interpreted models are fixed does not change exact T_{L,J,I}; Γ additionally indexes only the frame-subtracted residue.

authority.note: Frozen baseline source. Historical PR #453 is provenance only and is not authority for this packet.

representation_class.name: R_bin^Seq
representation_class.transition: S→_π P iff P is a premise of some backward MLL rule instance with conclusion S
representation_class.membership: The rule-induced projected relation is the unique member; analyst-supplied alternative binary relations are outside the bounded class.

decoder_class.name: D_succ
decoder_class.definition: Prov is the least fixpoint of Φ(X)(S)=T(S)∨g({X(P):S→P}), where T(S) holds iff S concludes a zero-premise rule instance, g:P({0,1})→{0,1} is monotone, g(∅)=0, and one uniform g is used for all S.

witnesses.S_or_fact: unprovable, nonterminal, and has a provable projected successor; refutes OR and NONEMPTY
witnesses.S_and_fact: provable, nonterminal, and has an unprovable projected successor; refutes TERM and AND

far_core_014_bounded_definitions.bounded_result: No pair in R_bin^Seq×D_succ computes MLL provability.
far_core_014_bounded_definitions.scope_guard: This is not an impossibility for arbitrary binary relations, arbitrary decoders, or richer state types. Resource-labelled hyperedges on individual sequents and a binary relation on frontier multisets are adequate constructions.
